verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's features page lists 140 region-specific gateways to integrate, including PayPal and Amazon Pay (both wallet-style methods), alongside WooPayments and Stripe. These come through gateway integrations, while the bundled defaults are cards, BACS, checks and cash on delivery. Nothing shows Apple Pay or Google Pay, express or one-click buttons, or saved-detail checkout. missing for 10: explicit Apple Pay/Google Pay support, express checkout buttons that skip re-entering details, native one-click checkout, first-party wallet configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
